name: Can I remove tree roots from my sewer line myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove tree roots from my sewer line myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attempting to remove tree roots from a sewer line yourself is generally not recommended. Without specialized equipment like professional-grade augers or hydro-jetters and expertise in their operation, you risk damaging your pipes or only partially clearing the blockage, leading to quick recurrence. Professional plumbers can identify the exact location and extent of the intrusion with camera inspections, ensuring complete removal and preventing further issues. Improper DIY attempts can lead to costly repairs if pipes are damaged. It is a practical tradeoff to rely on professionals to avoid exacerbating the issue or causing damage to your plumbing system.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY root removal is not recommended as it risks pipe damage and incomplete clearing; professional tools and expertise are needed for effective, safe removal.
